anomaly_detection.rationale: Tukey IQR fence over 16 engaged contacts (median 4.0, Q1 2.8, Q3 5.2, IQR 2.5): threshold = ceil(Q3 + 1.5*IQR) = 9 interactions.

narrative.text:
Pipeline movement has plateaued across the 7, 14, and 30-day windows, with nearly all activity concentrated in the last 7 days. The vast majority of transitions occurred on 2026-09-21, showing a sudden burst of movement rather than a steady climb. This activity was heavily concentrated in the subscriber and lead stages, though it pushed a few contacts further down the funnel.

Key movement was seen with dsmith@chewy.com moving to opportunity and contacts from Apollo Hospitals and Chewy Ltd reaching marketingqualifiedlead. We also saw a transition to evangelist for kai8karma+speaker-qhamirani@gmail.com. It is important to note that 7 of the 39 transitions in the 7-day window were seeded by the pipeline, and the remaining 32 were written by the system in a demo portal, meaning this is not organic buyer movement.

Despite the high volume of transitions, several engaged contacts have stalled. Specifically, contacts like rjohnson@wayfair.com, jwilson@planetfitness.com, and maryam.alzaabi@almarai.com remain in the subscriber stage without further progression.
